Definition: a pot (for boiling); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket
BiblicalUsage: A pot or basket, the vessel of the tabernacle and the kitchen, into which the priest's servant thrust his fleshhook, and in which the Passover lambs were boiled. The king of Israel's men put the heads of Ahab's sons in baskets, and Jeremiah saw two baskets of figs set before the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a pot is only a pot until God fills it with meaning, and the baskets of figs in Jeremiah were a sermon about good and bad alike. What I carry matters less than who carries me.
